samples.label: native_tts_sample.wav
samples.description: Genuine on-device/native TTS: macOS `say -v Samantha`, converted to 24kHz mono PCM16 to match the Fish sample before resampling for DNSMOS — the literal category of failure this product's canonical scar was about

finding: The native/on-device sample scored HIGHER than the real Fish sample on every DNSMOS sub-metric. DNSMOS is a denoising/signal-clarity metric, not a naturalness/expressiveness metric, so it does not discriminate correctly for this product's actual claim (premium neural voice vs on-device voice) and is not used as the shipped naturalness gate.
